Definition: from a compound of G2596 and τέμνω (to cut); a cutting down (off), i.e. mutilation (ironically):--concision. Compare G609.
BiblicalUsage: Beware of dogs, beware of evil workers, beware of the concision.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Paul's warning is blunt because the danger is real, and the true circumcision is the heart.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
